5.0.SP2.description: Deprecated in FIX.4.3 See Appendix 6-F: 13.Removed Deprecated Field: OnBehalfOfSendingTime (tag 370) [Deprecated and Replaced in FIX 4.3, Removed in FIX 4.4] Used when a message is sent via a 'hub' or 'service bureau'. If A sends to Q (the hub) who then sends to B via a separate FIX session, then when Q sends to B the value of this field should represent the SendingTime on the message A sent to Q. (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as 'GMT')
